name: Ojasvi Custom Login Styler
author: virendra06

sections.description:
Ojasvi Custom Login Styler lets you customize the WordPress login page without coding.

You can change:
* Login logo
* Background color or background image
* Overlay color on background image
* Login button color and hover color

All settings are available under:
Settings → Ojasvi Login Styler
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Ojasvi Login Styler and configure your login design
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require coding?

No. Everything can be managed from the WordPress dashboard.

Will it affect front-end theme design?

No. It only applies changes to the WordPress login page.
sections.changelog:
